stem:
Meera is doing a science project at home. She directs several parallel rays of sunlight towards three transparent objects one by one: a thin flat glass plate, a convex lens, and a concave lens.
She observes what happens to the rays after they pass through each object.
Which row correctly describes what happens to the parallel rays?

options.text: thin glass plate: converge convex lens: converge concave lens: diverge
thin glass plate: pass through unchanged convex lens: converge concave lens: diverge
thin glass plate: diverge convex lens: converge concave lens: pass through unchanged
thin glass plate: pass through unchanged convex lens: diverge concave lens: converge

teacher.key_rationale: A thin flat glass plate lets parallel rays pass through essentially unchanged (negligible convergence/divergence), a convex lens converges parallel rays to its focal point, and a concave lens diverges parallel rays. This matches option B. Options A and C trap students who assume any transparent object must bend parallel rays; D traps students swapping the lens actions.
